title: The name Jesus above every name
english: God [[gave the name that is above every name >> Bible:Philippians 2:9]] to our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. That name above every name is Jesus. Therefore [[in the name of Jesus every knee bows — of those in heaven and on earth and under the earth >> Bible:Philippians 2:10]]. Through many generations no one was called by it. Moses wrote Genesis: Abraham and many righteous men — yet none deserved to be named Jesus: not Abel, not he who [[began to call on the name of the Lord >> Bible:Genesis 4:26]], not Enoch, not Noah, not Abraham, not Isaac, not Jacob, not even Moses [[faithful in all God’s house >> Bible:Numbers 12:7]]. I first find the name Jesus in Exodus: [[Amalek came and fought Israel, and Moses said to Jesus at Rephidim >> Bible:Exodus 17:8-9]]. That is the first naming. Moses confesses he cannot lead the army; he calls Jesus: [[Choose for yourself strong men >> Bible:Exodus 17:9]]. Where I first learn the name Jesus, I also see the mystery: Jesus leads the army.

title: Moses’ hands and Jesus the helper
english: [[When Moses lifted his hands, Israel prevailed; when he let them fall, Amalek prevailed >> Bible:Exodus 17:11]]. Jesus grows strong and conquers when Moses raises his hands. The people were beaten by Amalek when Moses’ hands hung down — when the law ceased among them who, [[seeking to establish their own righteousness, were not subject to the righteousness of God >> Bible:Romans 10:3]]. Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Jethro are left to judge the people; Jesus is not left behind but follows Moses up the mountain and [[stood by Moses >> Bible:Exodus 24:13]] — not as second or inferior, but as helper and protector. When he was sent to spy, his name is written Hosea (Ause); when he returns and lifts the fallen people, Moses names him Jesus. When Moses’ face was transfigured and Israel could not bear the sight, Jesus not only looks on the face but remains inside the tabernacle, privy to the mysteries.

title: The book paints Christ’s sacraments
english: Where does all this look? This book does not so much report the deeds of Nun’s son as depict the sacraments of my Lord Jesus. He it is who, after Moses’ death, took the command; he leads the army and [[fights Amalek >> Bible:Exodus 17:9]]; what was foreshadowed on the mountain with outstretched hands he [[nails to his cross, triumphing over principalities and powers >> Bible:Colossians 2:14-15]]. [[Moses died >> Bible:Deuteronomy 34:5]] — for the law ceased, since [[the law and the prophets were until John >> Bible:Matthew 11:13]]. Hear the Gospel: [[They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them >> Bible:Luke 16:29]] — naming Moses as the law. Hear the Apostle: [[a woman is bound to the law while her husband lives; if the husband dies she is free >> Bible:Romans 7:2-3]] — the woman being the soul held under Moses’ law. Therefore the law must die, so that those who believe in Jesus may not incur the charge of adultery.

title: Jordan, ark, and Rahab’s soul
english: Jesus my Lord and Savior has taken the principate. Compare Moses’ deeds with Jesus’ rule. When Moses led Israel from Egypt there was no order in the people, no observance among the priests; they crossed [[the salt sea with a wall of water on right and left >> Bible:Exodus 14:22]]. When my Lord leads: [[priests go before, the ark of the covenant is borne >> Bible:Joshua 3:6]]; not the sea but the Jordan — not in panicked flight but with priests shouldering the ark, with trumpets sounding a heavenly mystery. He who [[came to break down the middle wall of partition made both one >> Bible:Ephesians 2:14]]: one part of the water stood, the other flowed to the sea. [[Prepare food for the journey >> Bible:Joshua 1:11]] — works that accompany us as faithful provision for the way ahead. Once we cross, [[manna ceases >> Bible:Joshua 5:12]]; whoever has not prepared food cannot follow Jesus into the land of promise. First fruits in the land: [[from the region of palms, and unleavened bread >> Bible:Joshua 5:11]] — the palm of victory, and, [[casting out the leaven of malice, the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:8]]. Jesus sends spies to Jericho’s king; a harlot receives them — each soul was a harlot while it lived in fleshly desires; it receives [[the angels he sent before his face to prepare his way >> Bible:Mark 1:2]], and lodges them not in low places but on high.

title: Flax, the world’s prince, and the sun standing still
english: I do not take without mystery the [[flax stalks in which the spies hid >> Bible:Joshua 2:6]] — flax is priestly clothing; [[you are a holy nation, a royal priesthood >> Bible:1 Peter 2:9]]. The harlot enters enmity with Jericho’s king — [[flesh lusts against the spirit >> Bible:Galatians 5:17]]; [[the world hates you >> Bible:John 15:18]]. That hostile king is the [[prince of this world >> Bible:John 12:31]]; he cannot seize Jesus’ spies because they travel the mountains: [[I lift my eyes to the hills; whence comes my help? >> Bible:Psalm 121:1]]. Moses never said [[Let the sun stand >> Bible:Joshua 10:12]]; Jesus did — [[Sun, stand over Gibeon, and moon over the valley of Aijalon >> Bible:Joshua 10:12]] — and Scripture adds that [[God never so listened to a man >> Bible:Joshua 10:14]]. My Jesus still makes the sun stand in his coming: while we [[wrestle against principalities and powers >> Bible:Ephesians 6:12]], the [[sun of righteousness >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]] stays with us — [[Behold, I am with you all days until the end of the age >> Bible:Matthew 28:20]].

title: Every place your feet subdue
english: See what Jesus promises his soldiers: [[Every place you set the soles of your feet shall be yours >> Bible:Joshua 1:3]]. To them it meant Canaanite regions; to us it means diabolic nations of opposing powers against which we sweat in this life’s contests. However many of those nations we subdue underfoot, we receive their provinces as Jesus distributes them. They were once angels in God’s kingdom — [[How you have fallen, Lucifer, who rose in the morning! >> Bible:Isaiah 14:12]]. If I can conquer him and the Lord [[crushes Satan under my feet >> Bible:Romans 16:20]], I may deserve Lucifer’s place in heaven. Anger, pride, envy, greed, lust each have goading angels; unless you defeat those vices in yourself and drive them from the land already sanctified by baptism’s grace, you will in no way receive the fullness of the promised inheritance.

title: The land rests — second circumcision
english: Under Moses it was not said what is said under Jesus: [[The land rested from wars >> Bible:Joshua 11:23]]. Only by the Lord Jesus’ power can our land — where we struggle — cease from battles. Within us are Canaanites and Perizzites; therefore [[meditate on the Lord’s law day and night >> Bible:Psalm 1:2]]. Many of you sleep not only by night but all day in worldly business or fleshly delights, and scarcely come to church on feast days — some who come attend to stories, not God’s word. [[Awake, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you >> Bible:Ephesians 5:14]]. You have fasted? It is as if you left Egypt and followed Moses; but now Jesus has taken you from Moses and [[circumcises you a second time at the hill of foreskins >> Bible:Joshua 5:2-3]] — not only casting off idol-worship but also greed, a subtler idolatry. [[Today I have rolled away from you the reproach of Egypt >> Bible:Joshua 5:9]]. If you receive this second circumcision of the vices, Egypt’s reproaches are wiped away and you inherit the heavenly kingdom through the true Jesus Christ our Lord, [[to whom be glory forever. Amen >> Bible:Galatians 1:5]].
